propositions: Each of 884 production Pandoc conversion calls resolves _pandoc_timeout() independently, causing redundant repository-root discovery via git rev-parse --show-toplevel (1,770 total Popen calls: 884 Pandoc + 886 git-root probes).

Resolving _pandoc_timeout() once per render pass and threading it through _render_unit and _convert preserves byte-identical outputs, all 884 real Pandoc invocations, and per-unit fallback behavior while reducing root-discovery probes from 886 to 3 (887 total Popen calls).

Timeout configuration must remain resolvable once at the render-pass boundary via optional parameters, allowing direct callers like test_wiki_render_corpus.py:325 to retain safe defaults while hoisting the cost outside production conversion loops.

Per-unit timeout fallback, Pandoc stdin/argv behavior, byte-equivalence to all 884 expected outputs, and whole-process-group reap semantics must remain unchanged and fully covered after consolidating timeout resolution.
